name: browser-use
headline: Android agent skills for AI tools
short_description: Standardized agent skills for teaching AI assistants like GitHub Copilot, Claude, and Gemini modern Android development practices, including Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Benefits operations teams by automating development tasks and improving code quality.
author: new-silvermoon

sections.overview:
Awesome Android Agent Skills is a repository of specialized capabilities designed to enhance AI coding assistants like GitHub Copilot, Claude, and Cursor with expert knowledge of modern Android development. Agent Skills are standardized packages that contain instructions, best practices, and architectural guidance for implementing Android features using current standards like Jetpack Compose, Hilt, and Room database. When an AI agent detects you're working on a relevant Android development task, it automatically loads the corresponding expert instructions from a SKILL.md file, ensuring consistency and accuracy across your codebase. This approach eliminates the need for repetitive prompts about architecture decisions or best practices, allowing agents to execute tasks with the latest 2025 Android development patterns built in. The repository includes a foundational Agent.md file that all AI agents read implicitly to understand your project's architecture and testing philosophy.
Teach AI assistants MVVM architecture patterns for Android projects
Automate implementation of Jetpack Compose UI components with best practices
Enforce accessibility standards across Android development tasks
Standardize testing approaches across your development team
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.

requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
